name: Grade 8 IIIT Practice: October Week 7 - Debugging
description: Practice words for Grade 8 third-trimester app, Python, and Micro:bit work.

words.definition: To use Python errors, test results, or traces to find and fix a coding problem.
words.example: The student can debug the game by reading each error message.

words.definition: The two-dot punctuation mark used in Python blocks.
words.example: The missing colon stopped the if block from running.

words.definition: Spaces at the start of a code line.
words.example: Indentation showed which lines belonged inside the loop.

words.definition: Checking how two values are related.
words.example: The comparison checked whether the guess equaled the secret number.

words.definition: The name used for a value in code.
words.example: The variable name had to match everywhere in the program.

words.definition: A problem that stops code or makes it wrong.
words.example: The error appeared because the input was treated as text.

words.definition: A change that solves a problem.
words.example: The fix converted the input to a number before comparing it.
